limits: the producer is matched by repr equality against the rejected operand; a repr collision attributes the wrong producer, which this cannot detect without identity capture inside the assertion
only frames of the file under repair are traced, so a producer in another file is invisible by design
'the fix changed that function' is necessary, not sufficient: a function can be changed for a reason unrelated to the rejected value
value-based fault localisation exists in the literature with learned rankers; this asks the narrower, parameter-free question and makes no comparison with those rankers

why_this_round.the_answer_being_tested: if the producer of the rejected value is usually a function the real fix changed, then the observation that identifies an edit can be produced by tracing, and repair is identification again
why_this_round.the_gap_it_closes: rounds 22-24 showed the proposal cannot come from vocabulary, corpus, refusal or check; round 24 named the only remaining observation, the provenance of the rejected value, and this measures it
why_this_round.why_it_could_fail: repr matching may miss; the fix may be in a sibling of the producer; the value may be produced by a correct expression from wrong operands
